body:
# seocho 0.6.0

First PyPI release since 0.4.1 (2026-05-17). The 0.5.0 prep (2026-06-05) was
never uploaded; this release supersedes it and includes its semantic-layer /
arbiter and ontology-engineering content.

## Highlights

**Operating layer (AgentOS)** — `seocho.agentos.AgentOS` binds admission
control, pinned tenancy (model-supplied workspace params are always
overwritten), token budgets with structured exhaustion, and always-disclosed
truncation over the governed store path and the OpenAI Agents SDK. Scheduler:
light/heavy lanes, per-lane EWMA fast-fail, work-conserving priority reserve —
all off by default. Guarantees are measured, not asserted (ADR-0164..0168):
cross-tenant leaks 21 → 0 under attack, budget overshoot under one turn,
truncation disclosure 0 → 1.0, control-plane overhead ≤ 4.1%.

**Structured query engine** — `Seocho.ask(..., engine="structured")`:
pinned-schema resolve → ontology-grounded text2cypher (declared identifiers
only, fully parameterized, workspace-scoped) → guardrail → governed execute →
synthesizer, with a bounded guardrail-rejection repair loop and honest abstain
reasons (`structured_no_evidence` vs `structured_guardrail_rejected`).

**Identity / shared memory** — `SharedInternTable` read-side canonical
resolver (homonyms surface candidates, never a silent guess), opt-in
cross-source convergence (`NodeDef.cross_source_unique`), and workspace-scoped
graph MERGE so two tenants' identical canonical id never share a node.

**Provenance + layered security** — content-addressed fact ids tying Postgres
ground truth to graph nodes with value-free PROV-O bundles (`seocho.provenance`),
and dataset/row/cell/sub-cell security over a default-deny lattice with a
redaction audit trail (`seocho.security_levels`).

**Agents SDK orchestration** — ontology guardrail wired onto factory agents;
controlled query agent (single deterministic tool) with Supervisor routing to
it by default. Orchestration is consumed from the SDK; deterministic bodies
stay SEOCHO's (ADR-0217).

**Ergonomics** — client namespaces `sc.index` / `sc.governance` /
`sc.platform` / `sc.sessions`; `seocho.ontology` subpackage (public API
unchanged); read-only connector materialization layer (Notion, Slack, DataHub,
PostgreSQL, Neo4j/DozerDB).

## Changed / Removed

- Tracing backend contract is now `none | console | jsonl | otlp`; the **Opik
  backend was removed** (ADR-0172). Metrics consolidate into the
  `seocho.metrics` registry.
- New extras: `otel`, `postgres`, `memory-bench`.

## Validation

- `bash scripts/ci/run_basic_ci.sh` green on the release commit
- clean-venv wheel + sdist build, `twine check` PASSED
- fresh-venv import smoke of all headline modules, `seocho --help`,
  `Seocho.local(...)` construction against embedded LadybugDB

## Known gaps

- Live LLM/graph end-to-end and answer quality are tracked separately
  (ADR-0214/0218 caveats: small n, judge unaudited).
- `Seocho.local(...)` without an `api_key` fails at construction with an
  upstream OpenAI-branded credential error; a SEOCHO-native message is a
  follow-up.
- `runtime/` (agent server, policy) remains git/Docker-distributed by design;
  the wheel ships the SDK only.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full entry.
